normalized_query.description: The exact string sent to Europe PMC after normalization (token quoting, dedup, truncation).

status.description: ok: records returned and constraint_evidence populated. no_hits: Europe PMC returned hitCount=0. filtered_out: hits existed but were dropped by the local date filter. Downstream tools MUST treat no_hits / filtered_out as missing literature grounding.

constraint_evidence.description: Structured IDs (go_terms, uniprot_accessions, interpro_ids) derived from text-mined annotations, plus pH/temperature scraped from abstracts. Empty {} when status != 'ok'.

text_mined_annotations.description: Raw Europe PMC annotation entities bucketed by type (gene_proteins, chemicals, organisms, accession_numbers, go_terms, diseases).
